about.title: A global name, an Iranian standard.
about.intro: Winston has been part of the global tobacco landscape since 1954, distributed in Iran under license with the same commitment to quality that defines the brand worldwide.

sections.title: Our Heritage
sections.body: Founded in Winston-Salem, North Carolina, the Winston name has represented bold, honest tobacco character for generations. Every market the brand enters inherits that same standard.

sections.title: Quality Commitment
sections.body: From leaf selection to final packaging, every stage of production follows strict quality protocols to ensure consistency across every pack sold.

sections.title: Responsible Marketing
sections.body: Winston Iran markets exclusively to adults of legal smoking age and supports clear, honest communication about the risks of tobacco use.

brandStory.title: The character behind the pack.
brandStory.intro: Every brand has a story. Winston's is about consistency, confidence, and a refusal to cut corners.

chapters.title: The Beginning
chapters.body: Winston launches in the United States, quickly becoming known for its distinctive, full-bodied character.

chapters.title: Going Global
chapters.body: The brand expands across international markets, adapting to local preferences while preserving its core identity.

chapters.title: The Modern Collection
chapters.body: Winston continues to evolve its portfolio, offering a range of blends and formats built on the same founding principle: quality without compromise.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to common questions about Winston products and this website.

items.question: Where can I purchase Winston products?
items.answer: Winston products are available through licensed tobacconists and retailers across Iran. This website does not sell products directly.

items.question: How can I verify a product is authentic?
items.answer: Authentic Winston packs carry official tax stamps and packaging markings as required by Iranian regulation. Contact us if you have concerns about a specific product.

items.question: Does this website sell tobacco products online?
items.answer: No. This website provides brand and product information only. It does not process online sales of tobacco products.

items.question: Who can view this website?
items.answer: This website is intended exclusively for adults of legal smoking age. An age verification check is required before viewing site content.

items.question: How do I report an issue with the website?
items.answer: Please use the contact form to report any technical issues, and our team will respond as soon as possible.
